name: depth-pass-still
prompt: Using the Crucible MCP tools and the render-crucible-media skill: create a scene with a ground slab and a box, look at it, then render a 640x360 PNG still that also writes a depth pass. Wait for the job to finish, read its result, release it, and finish by calling scene_export_recipe. Keep it short.
expected: scene_render_submit was called with kind image and passes including depth, status was polled, the result was read and the job released.
